brief: A contacts app as a social constellation — closeness reflects relationship, interactions glow

dominant_strengths: Strong conceptual metaphor — orbs as people forming a constellation feels poetic and visually distinctive against deep dark canvas
Cohesive vibrant palette with glowing dots reads as living, emotional network rather than a sterile contact list
Clean sidebar typography hierarchy with tasteful gradient logo and muted secondary labels supports the reflective tone
dominant_weaknesses: Constellation lacks legibility — orbs have no labels, no connecting lines, no closeness encoding visible, so the metaphor is decorative not functional
Spatial composition feels arbitrary: orbs cluster top-left while vast empty canvas dominates, wasting two-thirds of the screen
Behavioral affordances are weak — no hover states implied, no clear mapping between sidebar list and floating orbs, interaction model is opaque
fix_priorities: Add subtle connection lines and proximity-to-self encoding so closeness actually reflects relationship as briefed
Surface names/initials on orbs and sync hover state between sidebar and constellation for legibility
Rebalance composition — center the constellation or let it breathe across the canvas instead of crowding one quadrant
Define a glow/pulse system tied to recent interactions to deliver the 'interactions glow' promise
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral and reflective lead through poetic metaphor and palette, but behavioral layer is underbaked — you can't tell who is who or how to act.
rationale.intent_fit: Captures the constellation aesthetic beautifully but only half-delivers the brief since closeness and interaction-glow aren't legibly encoded.
